_source: LocalMiniDrama backend-node/src/services/angleService.js —— 从源码字面量解析，并对全部 96 种 (h,v,s) 组合与 L 的 toPromptFragment / toChineseLabel 逐一校验一致，非手抄。

horizontalDesc.left: shooting from the left side, profile view
horizontalDesc.back: shooting from behind, character's back to camera
horizontalDesc.right: shooting from the right side, profile view

elevationDesc.worm: extreme low-angle worm's eye view, camera near ground pointing sharply upward, strong upward perspective distortion, background shows sky/ceiling
elevationDesc.low: low-angle upward shot, camera below eye-line, slight upward tilt, empowering perspective
elevationDesc.eye_level: eye-level shot, neutral perspective, natural horizontal framing
elevationDesc.high: high-angle bird's eye view, camera above looking down, background shows floor/ground with downward perspective distortion

shotSizeDesc.close_up: close-up shot (face/bust framing), subject fills most of frame, shallow depth of field, background softly blurred
shotSizeDesc.medium: medium shot (waist-up to full body), character and immediate surroundings visible, moderate depth of field
shotSizeDesc.wide: wide shot (full body with environment), subject small relative to scene, deep depth of field, environment context prominent
